title: Yellowed Roasted Chinese Oysters Mu Shu
description: A roasted, creamy, and cozy Chinese dish featuring oysters, made with plant-based friendly ingredients and sous-vide cooking method, served in a mu-shu form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat.
Spread the mushroom and tofu mixture on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the oysters by seasoning with salt and pepper.
Sous-vide cook the oysters at 130 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Warm the mu-shu wrappers by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the mu-shu by placing a few pieces of the roasted mushroom and tofu mixture onto a wrapper, followed by a cooked oyster and some chopped scallions.
